name: FIA — Public Services Portal (Cyber Crime Complaints)
description: Official Federal Investigation Agency portal for registering complaints with the Cyber Crime Wing, including online fraud, scams, and online harassment.

name: FOSPAH — Federal Ombudsperson Secretariat for Protection against Harassment
description: Official federal body that receives and decides harassment complaints, including workplace harassment under the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010.

name: NADRA — National Database and Registration Authority
description: Official authority for CNIC and identity documents — apply for a duplicate CNIC and report misuse of lost identity documents.

name: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports
description: Official authority for Pakistani passports, including guidelines and the process for replacing a lost passport.

name: Punjab Police
description: Official Punjab Police portal — online complaint registration, FIR checklist, and information about your nearest police station.

name: Sindh Police
description: Official Sindh Police portal with the IGP Complaint Management System for registering and tracking complaints.

name: Pakistan Code — Federal Laws Portal
description: Official Government of Pakistan repository of federal laws — read the actual text of the Pakistan Penal Code and other statutes.
